Welcome—I'm glad you're here. Have you ever wondered how the simple act of reading can actually shape your mind, nurture your faith, and even deepen your wisdom? In the Christian tradition, words on a page have always been more than just ink and paper—they're invitations to grow, to reflect, and to discover new depths in both our hearts and our understanding.
Together, we're about to step into the world of Lit!: A Christian Guide to Reading Books, thoughtfully crafted by Tony Reinke. This isn't just another guide; it's a companion for anyone who wants to explore how reading—whether it's scripture or stories from across the world—can become a powerful part of your journey with God.
We're going to look at those big questions: What should we read? How can we read in a way that really matters? And why does reading hold such a special place in our lives of faith? Every page you turn can be more than just a search for knowledge—it can be an act of worship, a moment for transformation, and a chance to encounter truth in a fresh way.
As we navigate this incredible landscape of literature together, you'll find practical tips for choosing and enjoying books—Christian and secular alike—mixed with a warm invitation to read with discernment, humility, and even joy. Imagine seeing books not simply as sources of information, but as lifelong companions that shape your character, deepen your perspective, and draw you closer to God Himself.
So, let's get ready to open up this rich world of reading—where every story, every idea, and every thoughtful moment can become part of a lifelong adventure in growth, connection, and faith. Are you ready? Let's explore it together.
